description: Audit of the current GO annotation set on Rnr4, focusing on the qualifier used with GO:0004748
code:
import pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
df=pd.read_csv("prov/rnr4_go_annotations.csv")
names={"GO:0004748":"ribonucleoside-diphosphate reductase activity (MF)",
"GO:0005515":"protein binding (MF)","GO:0016491":"oxidoreductase activity (MF)",
"GO:0046982":"protein heterodimerization activity (MF)","GO:0005971":"ribonucleoside-diphosphate reductase complex (CC)",
"GO:0005634":"nucleus (CC)","GO:0005737":"cytoplasm (CC)","GO:0009263":"deoxyribonucleotide biosynthetic process (BP)",
"GO:0106387":"pyrimidine deoxyribonucleotide biosynthesis (BP)"}
df["term"]=df.GO.map(names)
sub=df[df.GO.isin(["GO:0004748","GO:0016491"])][["GO","term","qualifier","evid","ref"]].sort_values(["GO","qualifier","evid"])
print(sub.to_string(index=False))
counts=df.groupby(["GO","qualifier"]).size().unstack(fill_value=0)
counts.index=[f"{g}\n{names[g][:38]}" for g in counts.index]
ax=counts.plot(kind="barh",stacked=True,figsize=(11,5.5),colormap="tab20")
ax.set_xlabel("number of GO annotation lines (QuickGO, UniProtKB:P49723)")
ax.set_title("Current GO annotations on yeast Rnr4 by term and relation qualifier")
ax.legend(title="qualifier",fontsize=8)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
sub.to_csv("prov/rnr4_GO0004748_audit.csv",index=False)
print("\nenables-qualified GO:0004748 lines:", (df[(df.GO=='GO:0004748')&(df.qualifier=='enables')]).shape[0],
      "| contributes_to lines:", (df[(df.GO=='GO:0004748')&(df.qualifier=='contributes_to')]).shape[0])
